subject: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@horizonhealth.com>, Jason Lee <jason.lee@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding

Hi Anna / Jason —

Great to be kicking this off. As discussed on the demo, we want to stand up Quality Monitoring (QMon) for your triage assistant in three short sprints so you have regressions surfaced before each model rollout. Attached is a tactical flightplan (PDF) with milestone dates, a sample prompt set, and a proposed canary/rollback matrix.

Top-level asks from us to you so we can schedule the implementation work this week:
- Confirm the initial prompt-set owners and a point person for label feedback (name + email)
- Share an example dataset of ~200 real prompts (redacted PHI if any) or confirm we can use synthetic replacements
- Procurement: confirm PO/contract path so we can enable Dedicated account on day 10 (procurement@)

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal kickoff (Redwood): Marissa + Rishi + Ben — scope mapping, infra checklist (today)
2) Customer kickoff: Marissa + Rishi + Horizon product + data steward — walk flightplan and agree on pilot scope (Mon)
3) Implementation sprint 1: prompt-set ingestion, eval harness integration, alert baseline (2 weeks)

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff with the team once you confirm availability.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: qmon-flightplan-v1.pdf, horizon-promptset-sample.json, canary-rollback-matrix.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding

Thanks Marissa — looping in implementation detail. Anna, a few clarifying items so we size the work accurately:

- Expected throughput: what’s the 95th percentile concurrent requests for the triage assistant during weekday peaks? (estimate OK)
- Typical prompt lengths (tokens) and whether you expect long clinical notes to be passed in full or summarized
- Any data retention limits or audit requirements (SaaS hosted vs private deployment) — I saw you requested Dedicated in the demo notes, so confirming timeline constraints

Implementation outline I’m proposing:
- Week 0 (kickoff): access provisioning, test dataset upload, prompt-set owner and labels mapping
- Week 1: Wire eval harness (we’ll run smoke evals on a copy of your promptset), configure regression alert thresholds, baseline metrics
- Week 2: Canary deploy with traffic shadowing (5% traffic) using the attached canary-rollback matrix; we’ll define rollback triggers at the token-error-rate and a 5% degradation in top-K accuracy for critical intents

I’ll prepare a short implementation checklist and post it to the Drive link. Ben, can you confirm the IAM tokens and temp creds cadence?

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Software Engineer, Inference Ops
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@horizonhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@horizonhealth.com>, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding

Hi Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for the plan. Quick answers:
- 95th pct concurrent: ~18 sessions (weekday peaks)
- Prompt lengths: median ~120 tokens; we have occasional long notes (1–2k tokens) — for the pilot we can provide summaries
- Retention: Horizon policy requires 90-day temp retention for analytics, but we can work with redacted copies for production until contract is signed. Procurement looped in.

Point people:
- Product owner: Jason Lee (jason.lee@horizonhealth.com)
- Data steward: Karen Ocampo (karen.ocampo@horizonhealth.com) — Karen will send redacted samples by EOD Friday

I’m available for the customer kickoff on Monday morning. Please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Anna Brooks
Director of Product, Horizon Health
anna.brooks@horizonhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding

Adding infra notes:
- I’ll provision a Dedicated sandbox with a 2x GPU pool and a workspace in us-west-2; credentials will be valid for 14 days for the pilot team (we’ll rotate per policy)
- I put a stub for an S3 share where Horizon can drop the sample prompts: s3://redwood-hzn-pilot/samples (I’ll share signed URLs via the Drive link)
- Canary config: we support traffic shadowing + true canary. For reduced blast radius we’ll start with shadowing for 48 hours, then ramp 2 -> 5 -> 10% over 24-hour windows if metrics hold.

I attached the canary-rollback-matrix.xlsx with trigger thresholds and the action checklist.

—Ben
Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Brooks <anna.brooks@horizonhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon flightplan & kickoff: Horizon Health onboarding

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed actions: 
- Horizon to share 200 redacted prompts and confirm PO path (Anna / Karen / procurement) by EOD Friday
- Redwood to provision Dedicated sandbox and share signed S3 URLs (Ben) by EOD Friday
- Kickoff meeting scheduled: Mon 2027-04-05 09:00 PT — invite sent
- Implementation owner: Rishi (technical), Marissa (CS coordination), Jason (Horizon product)

Attached flightplan is v1.0 — we’ll iterate after the kickoff. I’ll track open items in HubSpot HS-003421 and add the implementation checklist after Rishi posts it to Drive.

See you Monday,
Marissa
